title: 第25章 初露锋芒第26章 未及弱冠宗师之资
content_zh:
;;
“此次许家开业，同为洞溪村人，我徐家自然不能不有所表示。”
“这里是十颗气血丹，便是我此次的贺礼。”
“徐二爷这贺礼有些贵重啊。”许川淡笑道。
徐震道：“这贺礼自然不是那么好拿的，听闻你许家也有不少子弟在练武，不如同我徐家儿郎比试一番。”
“也算是为你家开业热闹热闹，如何？”
许川低头思索，许明烜道：“阿爹，十颗气血丹，不拿白不拿，就让我先来打头阵吧。”
见他如此急切，许川莞尔一笑，然后看向徐震，“徐二爷，那就比试个几场，点到为止。”
“武者切磋，伤筋动骨在所难免，如果怕了，你可以拒绝。”
“废话少说，第一场我来，你们出谁。”
徐震呵呵一笑，“许家还是有血性之人的，看你年纪不过十来岁，徐峰，你去跟他比试下。”
“是，二爷爷。”
出来的人比许明烜高半个头颅，也就十一二岁的年纪。
众人都是乐得看热闹，纷纷让开，给他们足够的空间比试。
许明烜的命格天赋虽然对于武道没有强有力的加持，但悟性却是不错，练习招式武技都极快。
这才同李治一起被天龙武馆后天巅峰强者看上，收为弟子。
虽然年仅九岁，但在许家全力支持下，也是打通了二十多穴窍的武者，至于李治练武天赋比许明烜高出许多。
离三流武者也只差一步。
徐峰也就打通了十六七个穴窍，内劲本就不如许明烜，加上武技也是不如，仅仅十几招就被拿下。
许明烜手下留情，只是伤了徐峰的胳膊。

这份气度引来周围人的交口称赞。
“好一个少年郎！”
“这许家教子有方啊！”
“未来定然可以崛起一方。”
许明烜看向徐震等人，道：“下一个谁来。”
“好骄狂的小子，徐威，你去。”
“是，二爷爷。”
徐威十五六岁的年纪，出手狠辣，二话不说，便探爪抓向许明烜的心口。
许明烜沉稳应对。
他虽然内劲不足，但武者比试也不是单纯的比拼内劲的多寡。
武学招式的运用，同样能成为胜负关键。
砰砰砰~
content_en:
;;
"This time the Xu family opens its business, as we are both from Dongxi Village, we, the Xu family, naturally have to express our feelings."
"Here are ten Qi and Blood Pills, which are my congratulatory gifts this time."
"Master Xu, this gift is a bit expensive." Xu Chuan said with a smile.
Xu Zhen said: "This gift is naturally not easy to get. I heard that many of your Xu family's children are practicing martial arts, so why not give it a try with me, the son of the Xu family."
"It's a lively opening for your home, how about it?"
Xu Chuan lowered his head and thought, and Xu Mingxuan said: "Dad, if you don't take the ten Qi and Blood Pills, it will be free. Let me take the lead."
Seeing how eager he was, Xu Chuan smiled, and then looked at Xu Zhen, "Second Master Xu, let's have a few contests until the point is reached."
"When warriors compete, it is inevitable that they will be injured. If you are afraid, you can refuse."
"Stop talking nonsense, I will do the first game, who will you choose?"
Xu Zhen laughed and said, "The Xu family is still full of blood. I see that you are only ten years old. Xu Feng, go and compete with him."
"Yes, Second Grandpa."
The person who came out was half a head taller than Xu Mingxuan, and was only eleven or twelve years old.
Everyone was happy to watch the excitement and got out of the way to give them enough space to compete.
Although Xu Mingxuan's destiny talent does not have a strong blessing on martial arts, his understanding is good and he can practice moves and martial arts very quickly.
It was only then that he and Li Zhi were spotted by the most powerful person in the Tianlong Martial Arts School and accepted him as a disciple.
Although he is only nine years old, with the full support of the Xu family, he is also a martial artist who has opened more than 20 acupuncture points. As for Li Zhi, his martial arts talent is much higher than Xu Mingxuan.
He is only one step away from becoming a third-rate warrior.
Xu Feng had only opened sixteen or seven acupuncture points. His internal energy was not as good as Xu Mingxuan's, and his martial arts skills were also inferior. He was defeated in just a dozen moves.
Xu Mingxuan showed mercy and only injured Xu Feng's arm.
This magnanimity attracted praise from people around him.
"What a young man!"
"The Xu family is very good at educating their children!"
"There will definitely be a rise in the future."
Xu Mingxuan looked at Xu Zhen and others and said, "Who's coming next?"
"What an arrogant boy, Xu Wei, go ahead."
"Yes, Second Grandpa."
Xu Wei was fifteen or sixteen years old, and he was ruthless. Without saying a word, he reached for Xu Mingxuan's heart with his claws.
Xu Mingxuan responded calmly.
Although he lacks internal energy, the competition between warriors is not simply about the amount of internal energy.
The use of martial arts moves can also be the key to victory or defeat.
Bang bang bang~
